Container.Name: expense-pilot
Container.Overview: Employment and business expenses, AI receipt drafts and overnight meals. Run prepare.sh to create the data directory before installing. Private GHCR image: authenticate Docker to ghcr.io first. Enter the generated setup token below. The setup script or first container start saves the logo in appdata. Icon URL uses this local file; if you change the host Appdata path, update Icon URL in Advanced View to match.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, receipts and session key. Keep this mapping during updates.

Config.Name: Setup token
Config.Description: Copy the random SETUP_TOKEN generated by prepare.sh. Required for first-run owner creation.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Reachable Ollama server URL. Leave blank for manual receipts.

Config.Name: Ollama model
Config.Description: Installed vision-capable model for receipt photos and scans.

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: Use true behind HTTPS. Use false for initial LAN HTTP setup.
